reason: I already take Toplux or Goli and reorder when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. A foil sachet every day also feels like more packaging waste.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I already have a supplement I reorder. My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, so I would ask the doctor before adding a new product.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take this exact form of magnesium, or a way to refill it without a new foil sachet every day.
